dining concept

1

When designing the layout of tables using the Russian service system, the sommelier’s guéridon service should be considered approximately 4.5-6 m2 of guest space per person. In terms of the quantity of tables, this is approximately 14-17 tables, plus private dining.

Total: up to 48-55 guests in main hall. With 600 m2, I would not put 60+ seats: technically possible, but privacy, wide aisles and a sense of real luxury will disappear.

If the mezzanine (second floor) is included in these 600 m2, it is logical to use it for a private dining for 8-10 people, lounge or wine room, and not for a dense main landing.

2

A reception area combined with a dressing room should be placed near the entrance group. It is also worth reserving space for racks with POS systems: there should be 2 of them: in the main hall, as well as near a private room on the second floor. Additionally, 1 POS system must be located in the bar area.

3

I suggest considering the idea of naming the spaces in the restaurant hall: the lower floor and the upper floor.

For the guest area on the ground floor, I suggest the following names: Le Grand Salon (refers not to the restaurant, but to the main hall of the house), La Galeria (forms an association not so much with paintings as with a place you want to go to), Le Jardin des Saisons (a place of leisurely dining, aperitifs and conversations).

Among the options for naming the second floor area: La Bibliothèque, Le Cercle de Maison Privé (a closed club associated with membership, privacy, and being chosen), Le Salon (indicates a place for intellectual meetings and conversations): in this way, a guest’s journey to the second floor will not be a banal move from the bottom to the top, but to another room. Maison Privé, which makes the restaurant not a commercial space, but a private residence. Here you can organize a smoking area (but only cigars), offer vintage drinks on carts, and access will be provided on the basis of individual consideration of applications for dinners.

If the second floor is a mystery, then the first floor should be an invitation. I wouldn’t even call them «upper» and «lower». Let’s make it two chapters of the same story.
